messages.content: I think I've been holding a grudge against my dad for something small for years.
Honestly, grudges over small things usually aren't really about the small thing anymore. What's the actual thing, if you don't mind?
He forgot my graduation because of work.
That's honestly not small at all, actually - missing a milestone like that is a real hurt, even years later.
I never told him how much it actually bothered me.
That's honestly worth saying now, even this late - grudges held silently tend to just calcify instead of resolve.
